notes: Short 3-page enacted amendment (Public Law 119-91) to the Sloan Canyon National Conservation Area Act. Full source read (5,713 chars); no referencedSources registered. Every substantive prose field decomposed. No material errors: all figures (48,438; 57,728; 9,290 computed; 1 year; 30 days; May 20, 2024; May 19, 2026; Public Law 119-91; sec. 505), directions (expand, mandatory, no-charge, no-wilderness), and entities (SNWA, BLM, Secretary of the Interior, Horizon Lateral Pipeline) verify verbatim. Minor issues only: 'Clark County, Nevada' is an unsourced geographic locator; 'adjacent BLM land' is an unsourced gloss for 'outside the boundaries of the Conservation Area'; and three low-impact omissions (the outside-boundaries scope on non-pipeline ROWs, the FLPMA sec. 202/503 notwithstanding override, and the geotechnical-investigation purpose).
